title: Carolina Collection 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar In Solid Brass | Antique Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels on the vanity and give your bathroom a dedicated, easy-to-reach place to hang them in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. This Carolina Collection towel bar brings traditional, timeless styling to classic bath accessories while keeping your space organized.

  • Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Pairs with matching Carolina pieces for timeless continuity
  • Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Save space in the bathroom with a wall-mounted design that keeps towels off counters and shelves.

Specs & Installation

  • Product type: towel bar
  • Collection: Carolina Collection
  • Overall size: 30 in L x 2 in D x 3.5 in H
  • Weight: 3.2 lbs
  • Material: solid brass
  • Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
  • multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
